title: COP31 Bulletin Day 13: New draft retains electrification goal but delays adaptation finance and science decisions
lede: The text says nations should aim to get 35% of global energy from electricity by 2035 but does not decide on an adaptation finance target or the timing of IPCC reports The post COP31 Bulletin Day 13: New draft retains electrification goal but delays adaptation finance and science decisions appeared first on Climate Home News .
